protocol_type: Master-polled half-duplex single-wire bus; address-based (64-bit ROM ID per slave).

channels.name: DQ
channels.description: Single data line carrying time-slot-encoded bits AND optionally parasitic power.

channels.name: GND
channels.description: Common ground for master + all slaves.

rom_commands_table.name: Read ROM
rom_commands_table.purpose: Read 64-bit ROM ID of the single slave on bus (only works if exactly 1 slave is present).

rom_commands_table.name: Match ROM
rom_commands_table.purpose: Address one specific slave by transmitting its 64-bit ROM ID.

rom_commands_table.name: Skip ROM
rom_commands_table.purpose: Broadcast to all slaves (no address; useful when only 1 device is present).

rom_commands_table.name: Search ROM
rom_commands_table.purpose: Binary-tree enumeration of all slaves; master discovers each ROM ID.

rom_commands_table.name: Alarm Search
rom_commands_table.purpose: Search ROM variant — only alarmed slaves respond.

rom_commands_table.name: Resume
rom_commands_table.purpose: Re-address the previously addressed slave without resending ROM ID.

rom_commands_table.name: Overdrive Skip ROM
rom_commands_table.purpose: Switch all slaves to overdrive speed.

rom_commands_table.name: Overdrive Match ROM
rom_commands_table.purpose: Match ROM and switch to overdrive speed.

fields.name: CRC-8
fields.purpose: CRC-8 over family code + serial number.

function_commands_examples.name: Convert T (DS18B20)
function_commands_examples.purpose: Start temperature conversion on selected slave.

transaction_sequence: 1. Master initiates a Reset Pulse (LOW for ≥ 480 µs at standard speed).
2. Slaves respond with a Presence Pulse (LOW for 60-240 µs after master releases).
3. Master issues a ROM Command (1 byte) to address a slave OR discover slaves.
4. If targeted ROM operation: master transmits 64-bit ROM ID.
5. Master issues a Function Command (device-specific 1 byte).
6. Master and selected slave exchange data via Write/Read time slots, LSB-first byte by byte.
valid_ready_handshake_rules: Slave devices indicate presence by pulling DQ LOW for 60-240 µs after master releases Reset.
Data is transferred bit by bit in time slots; the master always initiates each slot.
There is no general per-byte ACK — only the CRC-8 at the end of certain commands provides correctness checking.
